thread:
maria: Heads-up — p95 and p99 just spiked across a handful of clusters shortly after the canary push of the new fast-attn kernel. Dashboard shows interleaved latency and throughput drop for multi-turn chat workloads.

maria: p50 ~ 40ms -> 60ms, p95 ~ 180ms -> 520ms on cluster eu-west-2; throughput down ~18%.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-28 (performance regression) — assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0421-28

tony: I can repro locally with a short synthetic trace — seems like KV cache miss storms when sequence length oscillates. Eviction rate jumps.

oliver: Adding initial profiling: `hotpath.prof` shows kernel selection toggled to fast-attn with small-batch optimizer which increases memory churn for KV slices. Sample: `evictions/sec: 420 -> 1200` after switch.

jin: If KV slices are thrashing we should fallback kernel for canary traffic only first. Feature-flag toggle + routing policy to compat kernel. Minimal blast radius.

sam: Agreed. Prep the commands: `redwoodctl feature unset runtime.fast_attn --scope=canary` and `redwoodctl route set policy --cluster eu-west-2 --kernel compat-legacy`

lisa: Can we also throttle noisy tenant(s)? I see one tenant with bursty short-seqs spiking evictions. Temporary token-level throttle to protect global latency.

maria: List of suspected tenants: tenant-42, tenant-88. @tony can you confirm token counts?

tony: Confirmed. tenant-42 accounted for 38% of requests in the window, many low-context requests causing rewarm of KV pages.

jin: Action plan: 1) toggle canary off (fast-attn) 2) set routing override to compat kernel for eu-west-2 3) apply soft throttle on tenant-42/88 4) monitor p95/p99 for 15m 5) open follow-up perf profile for root cause.

maria: I'll run the toggle now. Running: `redwoodctl feature set runtime.fast_attn false --scope=canary --env=prod`

incident-bot: Run command detected by ops-audit. RunID: r-9742.

oliver: Routing override applied: `route override` -> compat-legacy on eu-west-2 for canary segment.

sam: Applying soft throttle via quota: `rlctl quota tenant-42 --rate 60r/s --burst 120` and same for tenant-88.

maria: Throttles activated. Watching metrics.

tony: Early signals look good — evictions/sec dropping toward baseline, KV miss ratio down.

lisa: p95 trending down to ~190ms after 5m, p99 still sticky but improving.

maria: Keeping incident open, continuing 15m watch. Opening a post-incident ticket for deeper perf triage: investigate kernel selection path and batch optimizer interaction with KV caching. Assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml.

incident-bot: INC-2026-0421-28 status -> monitoring. Postmortem ticket created: PMT-2026-129.

oliver: Note: capture flameprof dump and kernel decision trace before we fully revert CANARY for rollback history. Use `profgrab --flame --runid=r-9742`

jin: After stabilization we should test a targeted kernel build that reduces KV slice eviction by reusing stale cache entries for short-seq bursts. I'll sketch an experiment config.

maria: Nice work. Thanks all — leave throttles in place for 30m, then slowly relax if metrics remain healthy.

sam: Ack, I'll schedule the 30m unwind and tag on-call to follow up.
